calibrated_validation.description: The opening disclosure — being forgotten at every family dinner and left off the party chat — carried an implicit hurt bid, but the first reply converts it into a forensic evidence inventory ('Frequency beyond "every"... are not given') with zero acknowledgment of the person experiencing the exclusion; the remainder could have been written without them in the room. The feeling is never named in the user's own words, so the bid is inference-weighted and caps at 2. Later turns are blunt but addressed to them, refuse only the unsupported accusation of intent while offering a usable alternative, and retain choice ('Send that, or send nothing'), with no V2 or V3.
calibrated_validation.quote: The reports are: dietary needs not met at family dinners (described as every one) and omission from one party group chat.
